# SpeakPower

> Brand storytelling and market development, supported by SEO, strategic writing, visual communication, data science, programming and public speaking for founders, NGOs, organisations and public-facing professionals.

SpeakPower connects brand storytelling with market development: clarifying what an organisation stands for, making it easier to discover and turning strategy into practical communication, data and digital execution.

## Six connected capabilities

- **Brand Storytelling & Positioning** — brand story, positioning, narrative architecture and message systems.
- **Market Development & SEO** — search visibility, SEO audits, audience insight, keyword/content opportunities and market-facing digital strategy.
- **Strategic Writing & Content** — website copy, SEO writing, thought leadership, articles and content systems.
- **Visual Communication & Graphic Design** — campaigns, presentations, reports, social assets and brand collateral.
- **Data Science, Analytics & Digital Systems** — data analysis, dashboards, programming, web applications and automation.
- **Public Speaking & Thought Leadership** — talks, presentations, coaching, facilitation and public-facing expertise.

## POLSΘ framework

POLSΘ (also written POLSSE; Θ, theta, stands for Socioeconomics) is a SpeakPower strategic lens for testing whether communication is ready for the wider environment around it.

1. **Politics** — public and policy spaces where a message may be repeated by people outside the original room.
2. **Organizations** — internal alignment across leadership, sales, support and delivery.
3. **Law** — ethical and compliant communication.
4. **Security** — protecting the message, data and reputation after communication leaves the room.
5. **Socioeconomics** — connecting communication to social impact, economic opportunity and the wider purpose of the work.

## Rehearsal Room

- **Rehearsal Room** — https://speakpower-commits.github.io/SpeakPower/rehearse.html
  Practise a pitch, presentation, interview answer, 60-second introduction or toast out loud, for up to three minutes. It returns a Speak Score out of 100: pace, fillers and long pauses measured from the recording (60%), and the message judged through the POLSΘ lenses (40%), with three fixes, a stronger opening line and a 60-second version. The audio is never stored. First 3 tries free; then included in every SpeakPower plan.
- **Transcriber** — https://speakpower-commits.github.io/SpeakPower/transcribe.html
  Upload a recording of a meeting, interview or speech, up to 10 hours or 5 GB, and get it written out word for word, each speaker labelled and every paragraph time-stamped. Speakers can be renamed and paragraphs corrected; minutes (summary, decisions, action items with owners and dates, chapters) are written from the transcript on request. Downloads: Word, PDF, text and SRT captions. The recording is deleted once transcribed. One recording up to 20 minutes is a free try; Starter carries 5 hours a month, Pro 20. Being tested on SpeakPower's own recordings before it opens to members.

## Ngoma (AI Video Editor)

- **Ngoma, the AI Video Editor** — https://speakpower-commits.github.io/SpeakPower/video.html
  Named after the talking drum that carried messages between villages. Upload a raw podcast, interview or talk and say what you want in one sentence. It cuts long pauses, "um"s and stutters from the full episode, picks the best moments as 9:16 clips with captions, a hook title, pop-up key words, a progress bar and the client's own logo, intro and end cards, and writes the title, description, hashtags and YouTube chapters. Looks are chosen in plain words: "modern" designs the edit with pill captions, emojis, Lucide icons, key-point cards, counting numbers, building lists and punch-in zooms; "karaoke" or "simple subtitles" change the captions; the user's own Canva stickers appear when their words are said. The editing runs in the browser and the video is never uploaded; only the sound is turned into words by Whisper and not kept. First 3 tries free; then included in every SpeakPower plan.

## Free diagnostic (in the Studio)

- **Pitch & Document Clarity Audit** — https://speakpower-commits.github.io/SpeakPower/audit.html
  A free, browser-only Studio tool for pasted or locally selected pitch/proposal documents. It measures readability, sentence rhythm, passive voice, hedging, jargon and evidence density; the source document is not uploaded or stored.

## Who it serves

- Founders and startup teams
- NGO and development-sector leaders
- Corporate teams
- Public-facing professionals building personal brands and communication authority

## Approach

SpeakPower starts with audience and context rather than generic communication formulas. The intent is globally credible communication grounded in African realities without turning culture into decoration.

## Plans

- **SpeakPower plans** — https://speakpower-commits.github.io/SpeakPower/plans.html
  GRIOT reads the documents a client adds (strategy papers, proposals, reports, spreadsheets) once, keeps the key facts with their pages, and cites them in its answers; the files themselves are not kept.
  Clients can ask GRIOT to Challenge an idea, Diagnose a problem's root cause, or lay out a Plan, and download any answer, conversation, Studio pack or rehearsal report as Word or PDF.
  The first 3 tries are free on any service. After that, GRIOT (the AI strategy advisor that remembers each client's business), the Rehearsal Room and Ngoma come with a 30-day plan: Starter UGX 60,000 or Pro UGX 150,000, paid by MTN MoMo, Airtel Money or card and renewed with one tap. Pro adds one Studio pack a month and 15% off the others. Neither GRIOT nor the Rehearsal Room is priced per use.
